designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.intro: The live style guide of this app: what your product looks like today, and where to change it.

about.title: What this page is
about.body: Every color, type role and component below is rendered live from the tokens in packages/config/brand.css, through the same @fuutu/ui components your screens use. Nothing here is a screenshot: change a token and this page follows.
about.contract: DESIGN.md is the written contract: roles, rules and decisions in plain words. A test fails as soon as its colors drift from brand.css, and pnpm -F @fuutu/ui test checks every pair against WCAG AA.

edit.title: Edit the tokens
edit.description: Change the light and dark values in packages/config/brand.css. It is the only file you edit.

paste.title: Paste a theme
paste.description: Export a theme from tweakcn or ui.shadcn.com/create and paste it into brand.css unchanged.

skill.title: Let your agent do it
skill.description: Ask your coding agent to run the setup-brand skill with your brand colors, fonts and radius.

foundations.title: Foundations
foundations.description: Color roles with contrast measured live in your browser, the full palette, type roles, spacing, radius, elevation and icons. Nothing here is hard-coded; every value is read from the running CSS.

components.title: Components
components.description: Every primitive exported from @fuutu/ui, variants and states side by side: default, hover, focus, active, disabled and invalid, pinned without touching the mouse.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.description: Kit compositions built from those primitives and fed with real config: stats, pricing, auth card, media frames, logo rail and the mesh gradient.

doDont.title: Do & Don't
doDont.description: The rules from DESIGN.md, rendered as right and wrong pairs.

example.title: Example screen
example.description: A complete settings screen assembled only from tokens and @fuutu/ui: what your product looks like before you write a line of CSS.

colors.title: Color roles
colors.description: Every surface is tested with its foreground. The ratio on each tile is measured in your browser from the computed styles, so it follows light and dark mode and any edit to brand.css.

roles.title: Surface and foreground
roles.description: Each surface with its own text color. Needs 4.5:1.

textUse.title: Text on page surfaces
textUse.description: Roles that appear as text on background and card, like links and form errors. Needs 4.5:1.

areas.title: Area colors
areas.description: Each area ink on its own fill, and as text on background and card. Needs 4.5:1.

destructiveFill.title: Destructive fill
destructiveFill.description: Buttons and badges render literal white on the fill, and a 60% fill in dark mode. Measured as rendered.

primaryHover.title: Primary hover fill
primaryHover.description: The default button hover renders primary at 90% over the page. Measured as rendered.

focusRing.title: Focus ring
focusRing.description: Components draw focus as the ring at 50% over the surface. Measured as rendered. Needs 3:1.

nonText.title: Focus, form edges and charts
nonText.description: Non-text elements need 3:1 against the surface they sit on.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Every token in brand.css with the value the browser resolves right now. Switch the mode and the values change.

areas.title: Areas
areas.description: Four product areas each own a pastel fill and a darker ink of the same hue. Fill with bg-area-*, set text and icons with text-area-*-foreground, and never put opacity on area text.

header.label: Page header on an area backdrop
header.title: Members
header.description: Invite teammates and assign roles. Changes apply on their next sign-in.

type.title: Typography
type.description: Pick a role, do not invent sizes. Schibsted Grotesk for display and headings, Manrope for the interface, Geist Mono for code and identifiers.

display.name: Display
display.use: Hero headline on marketing surfaces. Fluid on marketing, 60px here.
display.sample: Ship the product, not the plumbing

body.name: Body
body.sample: Invite teammates and assign roles. Changes apply on their next sign-in.

small.name: Small
small.use: Captions, badges, metadata. Never primary content.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.description: A 4px base unit. Group related controls tightly and separate groups with a full card gap.

notes.6: Card padding, card gap, page gutter

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: One --radius drives the scale. Change it once to re-shape the product. Buttons and badges use rounded-full.

elevation.title: Elevation
elevation.description: Tactile surfaces lift with a soft shadow and a faint ring, never a border. Overlays get the larger shadows.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Lucide, outline style. size-4 inside controls, 20 to 24px when standalone. They inherit the text color.

stats.title: Stats cards
stats.description: Numbers read from the kit's own config, not made up. Add a locale or a plan and these change.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: PricingCompact fed by buildPricingTiers(), so tiers, prices and features come straight from PLANS and the feature catalog.

auth.title: Auth card
auth.description: The shell around every sign-in and sign-up screen. This form does not submit.

card.title: Welcome back
card.description: Sign in to continue to your workspace.
card.footer: Sessions, OAuth and two-factor ship with the kit.

media.title: Media frames
media.description: Wrap a screenshot, a video or any content. The chrome variant adds a window bar.

logos.title: Logo rail
logos.description: The stack at a glance. Hover or focus a logo for details.

nextjs.name: Next.js
nextjs.description: App Router and React 19 in all apps.

logos.single: A single item card, as the rail renders each logo.

mesh.title: Mesh gradient
mesh.description: Two ways to get the hero background. Both read --primary and --chart-4, so they follow the brand.

areas.title: color1="var(--area-users)" color2="var(--area-ai)"
areas.caption: CSS vars resolve at runtime. Area colors tint the hero while the primary stays ink.

roles.title: Name a role, not a color
roles.do: Components ask for bg-primary. Rebranding changes one file.
roles.dont: A palette color like bg-indigo-600 ignores dark mode and every future theme.

primary.title: One primary button per view
primary.do: One filled action, the rest step back to outline.
primary.dont: Three filled buttons compete. Nobody knows what the page wants.

colorAlone.title: Never rely on color alone
colorAlone.do: Icon and label carry the state. Color only reinforces it.
colorAlone.dont: A red dot without a label is invisible to screen readers and some eyes.
colorAlone.label: Payment failed

fills.title: Warning and info are fills, never text
fills.do: A filled callout always carries its own foreground color.
fills.dont: Amber text such as text-warning sits near 1.6:1 on a light surface.
fills.callout: Your trial ends in 3 days. Add a payment method to keep your plan.

intent.title: Destructive means irreversible
intent.do: The red button is reserved for an action that cannot be undone.
intent.dont: Red on a routine save teaches people to ignore red.

areaMark.title: Area color marks the area, never status
areaMark.do: The users tint labels the members area: tile, icon and badge.
areaMark.dont: A billing tint on a failed payment reads as status. Use bg-destructive and an icon instead.

areaOpacity.title: No opacity on area text
areaOpacity.do: Area ink stays solid on its own fill, so it keeps its measured contrast.
areaOpacity.dont: Fading the ink drops it below 4.5:1 on the pastel fill.

example.heading: Organization settings
example.subheading: Manage how your team works in Acme.

general.slugHint: Used in links like /organizations/acme. Changing it breaks existing links.
general.twoFactorHint: Members without it are asked to set it up on their next sign-in.

example.callout: All 5 seats on your Pro plan are in use. Add seats in Billing before you invite more people.

button.title: Button
button.description: Six variants. Use default once per view; destructive only for actions that cannot be undone.
button.label: Continue

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Status and metadata. A badge is not interactive, so hover, active and disabled do not apply.
badge.label: Active

form.title: Form controls
form.description: The pinned states use the same classes a real hover or keyboard focus does. Slider thumbs and one-time-code slots follow real focus only.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Field ties a label, a control, a hint and an error together. Error and disabled come from data-invalid and data-disabled.

error.name: With error
error.label: Email
error.message: Enter a full address, like you@company.com.

group.description: Group related choices in a field set.
group.digestHint: One summary instead of single emails.

overlays.title: Overlays
overlays.description: Each one opens from a real trigger. Press Esc to close.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.description: Focused tasks that keep the page behind it.
dialog.heading: Invite a teammate
dialog.body: They get an email with a link that expires in seven days.

alertDialog.title: Alert dialog
alertDialog.description: Confirms an action that cannot be undone.
alertDialog.heading: Delete Acme?
alertDialog.body: This removes all members, API keys and webhooks. It cannot be undone.

sheet.title: Sheet
sheet.description: Side panel for details and secondary forms.
sheet.heading: Audit log entry

dropdown.title: Dropdown menu
dropdown.description: Actions, toggles, choices and nested menus.
dropdown.label: Account

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: A short hint on hover and keyboard focus.
tooltip.text: Copies the key to your clipboard

toast.title: Toast
toast.description: Feedback that fades on its own. The app mounts one toaster for the whole product.

display.title: Display and navigation
display.description: Smaller building blocks you compose every day.

tabs.overviewBody: Plan, usage and members at a glance.
tabs.activityBody: The latest sign-ins and role changes.

alert.title: Heads up
alert.body: Seats are billed per member and adjust automatically.
alert.errorBody: Update your card to keep the Pro plan.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.description: Every sidebar part, in an inline copy of the app shell. The toggle and rail are disabled here.
